_about: Hidden Windows display set-up (Lineage11, owner's ruling 2026-11-24: the default platform is Windows). Run first by every example of chapters 10 and 11: pathlib.Path shows the Windows form (C: drive, backslashes, WindowsPath) when the program itself (code that is not in a .py file) prints or formats it, while the library code (pathlib, shutil, os) keeps the real system form so that files are found. 1.1.0 replaces 1.0.0: its string form broke Path.iterdir() and friends on absolute paths.
